ZMB.note: Digital ID is only described as future; no authentication service stated.
Nothing on the civil register stated.
Only a World Bank project to expand e-government services; no online service stated.
No enrolment in a national ID stated; only a target of four million digital IDs by 2030.
Nothing on a number at birth stated.

No register keyed on a national ID stated.

facts.fact: SMART Zambia's national coordinator said it will be building a national digital identity ecosystem, with a plan to issue four million digital IDs by 2030 under the World Bank-funded Digital Zambia Acceleration Project.

ZMB.note: SmartCare Pro is deployed in 2,054 facilities but the document does not say who builds or runs it.
Digital ID is only said to be usable for paying taxes in future; no electronic payment stated.
